Row.Text: National wonder. Your civilization earns [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]+0.5%[ENDCOLOR] treasury interest per turn above the global floating rate. The global rate rises when corporate borrowing is heavy (rewarding your savings more) and falls when capital is plentiful. Only one Bond Exchange may exist per civilization.

A Bond Exchange is an institution through which a government issues and trades sovereign debt, formalizing borrowing into a marketplace that sets interest rates through supply and demand. Historically, the Dutch Republic's perpetual annuities and the later development of Treasury markets transformed government finance, allowing nations to fund wars and infrastructure at predictable rates while giving investors a reliable return.

Build the Bond Exchange in your wealthiest city to maximize the 0.5% savings bonus. It is most valuable when global rates are already high — meaning the world economy is booming and corporate borrowing is heavy. In a high-rate world, your compounding treasury interest can become a significant gold source.

Set.Text: Allows you to build the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Bank[ENDCOLOR], a building which increases the [ICON_GOLD] Gold produced by a city, as well as the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Constabulary[ENDCOLOR], which hinders a spy's ability to steal your technology.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Treasury Interest:[ENDCOLOR] Your gold balance earns interest automatically each turn. The rate floats between [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]0.5%[ENDCOLOR] and [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]6%[ENDCOLOR] with corporate borrowing demand, which rises in an economic boom and falls in a downturn - so a hot world economy pays savers more. Build a [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Bond Exchange[ENDCOLOR] national wonder (also requires Banking) for an extra [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]0.5%[ENDCOLOR] on top. Track it all from the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]National Treasury[ENDCOLOR] panel, opened from the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Additional Information[ENDCOLOR] menu at the top-right of the screen.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Financial Markets:[ENDCOLOR] Once any civilization builds the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Global Stock Market[ENDCOLOR] world wonder, the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Financial Markets[ENDCOLOR] stock market opens for everyone (from the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Additional Information[ENDCOLOR] menu), where you buy and sell shares in six industry sectors for recurring [ICON_GOLD] Gold dividends each turn. Share prices rise and fall with the business cycle.
